## Summary
Implement student self-registration with email verification and an admin approval workflow so that only approved students can access exams.

## User story
As a student, I want to register for Journey OS with my institutional email, so that once an admin approves me I can access practice exams and assessments.

## Why this matters
Without student registration and approval, there is no way to gate exam access. Unapproved users could access FERPA-sensitive assessment items. The admin approval step ensures only verified MSM students enter the exam delivery pipeline.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Student can register via /register with institutional email (sends magic link via Supabase Auth)
- [ ] Registration creates a profiles row with role='student' and status='pending_approval'
- [ ] Admin sees pending students on approval dashboard with student email and registration date
- [ ] Admin can approve or reject a student via PATCH /api/admin/students/[id]/approve
- [ ] Approved students have status='active' and can access student routes
- [ ] Rejected students see a "registration pending" message, cannot access exams
- [ ] RLS policies prevent students from seeing other students' data
- [ ] Invalid/duplicate email registrations return clear error messages

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in API routes, createBrowserClient() in registration form |
| Data Layer | Row<'profiles'> from @journey/db/client — never hand-write user interfaces |
| Atomic Design | StudentRegistrationForm is organism in features/auth/components/, page.tsx < 30 lines |
| RLS | institution_id scoped policies — students see only own profile |
| AP-17 | If registration touches multiple tables, use supabase.rpc() not sequential inserts |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Add status column to profiles if not present
ALTER TABLE public.profiles
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_approval'
  CHECK (status IN ('pending_approval', 'active', 'rejected', 'suspended'));

-- Index for admin approval queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profiles_status_role
  ON public.profiles (status, role)
  WHERE role = 'student';

-- RLS policy for admin to read all student profiles in their institution
CREATE POLICY "Admins can read student profiles in institution"
  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING (
    role = 'student'
    AND institution_id = (
      SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- RLS policy for admin to update student status
CREATE POLICY "Admins can update student status"
  ON public.profiles FOR UPDATE
  USING (
    institution_id = (
      SELECT p.institution_id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND p.role = 'admin'
    )
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    institution_id = (
      SELECT p.institution_id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND p.role = 'admin'
    )
  );
```

## API contract
```
POST /app/api/admin/students
Headers: Cookie (admin session)
Response 200: { data: { students: [{ id, email, status, created_at }] }, error: null }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
Response 403: { data: null, error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Admin role required' } }

PATCH /app/api/admin/students/[id]/approve
Headers: Cookie (admin session)
Request: { action: 'approve' | 'reject' }
Response 200: { data: { id, status }, error: null }
Response 404: { data: null, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Student not found' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/auth/services/StudentRegistrationService.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type Profile = Row<'profiles'>;

export class StudentRegistrationService {
  async registerStudent(email: string, institutionId: string) {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    // Supabase Auth creates user, trigger creates profile with status='pending_approval'
    return supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
      email,
      options: { emailRedirectTo: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/auth/callback` }
    });
  }

  async approveStudent(studentId: string, action: 'approve' | 'reject') {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const status = action === 'approve' ? 'active' : 'rejected';
    return supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ status, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', studentId)
      .eq('role', 'student')
      .select()
      .single();
  }
}

// app/(student)/register/page.tsx — must be < 30 lines
import { StudentRegistrationForm } from '@/features/auth/components/StudentRegistrationForm';
export default function RegisterPage() {
  return <StudentRegistrationForm />;
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E07/E07-S01.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/admin/students returns 401 when not authenticated', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/students');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

test('PATCH /api/admin/students/[id]/approve returns 403 for non-admin', async ({ request }) => {
  // Authenticate as student, attempt approval
  const res = await request.patch('/api/admin/students/fake-id/approve', {
    data: { action: 'approve' }
  });
  expect([401, 403]).toContain(res.status());
});

// tests/E07/E07-S01.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Registration page renders email form', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/register');
  await expect(page.getByPlaceholder(/email/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /register/i })).toBeVisible();
});

test('Registration form validates institutional email', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/register');
  await page.getByPlaceholder(/email/i).fill('bad@gmail.com');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /register/i }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/institutional email/i)).toBeVisible();
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `ALTER TABLE public.profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS status;`
2. `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can read student profiles in institution" ON public.profiles;`
3. `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can update student status" ON public.profiles;`
4. No Neo4j changes to revert.
5. `git stash && git checkout develop`
